description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for handling Seeking Alpha Forward Sales Estimates data, including query parameters, data transformation, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: SAForwardSalesEstimatesQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Seeking Alpha forward sales estimates, including period and symbol validation.

classes.name: SAForwardSalesEstimatesData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for forward sales estimates, including actual sales and period growth.

classes.name: SAForwardSalesEstimatesFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming Seeking Alpha forward sales estimates data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SAForwardSalesEstimatesQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw estimates data from Seeking Alpha API based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of SAForwardSalesEstimatesData instances.
